note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative, jurisdiction unspecified; piece statuses and relationships are supplied by the author and nothing is decided by the animation.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional club rule with three cumulative conditions: the three fact pieces are pulled out of their pockets, each is related to its pocket (plain relation) and the gear line is drawn as a sequence from the drive through every pocket to the joint dial; the tracer runs down the line while pocket 2 enlarges; the pieces return and a test half-turn reaches the dial (all pieces supplied, as supplied).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a different fictional rule with four conditions where piece 3 is pending — its place is a dashed outline, the relation to pocket 3 is not supplied, the tracer visits pocket 3 (the focus) and the test turn stops at the empty pocket; the dial does not move.
